➗ Rational Expressions & Equations有理式与分式方程

Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简

x2+x−6x2−9​ and x−2x−3​ give the same output for almost every x — but at x=−3 the first one breaks. Knowing exactly where is half the marks.x2+x−6x2−9​ 和 x−2x−3​ 几乎对所有 x 都相等——但在 x=−3 处前者没有意义。准确找出这些点就拿到了一半的分。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简
  1. NPVs: values that make the DENOMINATOR zero — factor it, set each factor =0.不允许值：使分母为零的值——把分母分解，每个因式 =0。
  2. State NPVs from the ORIGINAL expression; a cancelled factor still counts.从原式写不允许值；约掉的因式照样算。
  3. Cancel FACTORS, never terms; b−aa−b​=−1.只能约因式，不能约项；b−aa−b​=−1。
BCAC​=BA​,B=0, C=0
b−aa−b​=−1,a=b

🧗 The hard part难点 · Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简

A denominator that starts with −x2分母以 −x2 开头

The opposite factor is hidden until you take out −1, and the sign of the answer flips.不提出 −1 就看不出相反因式，而且结果要变号。

  1. 6−x−x2=−(x2+x−6)=−(x+3)(x−2)
  2. NPVs now: x=−3, 2现在写不允许值：x=−3, 2
  3. 6−x−x22x2−8​=−(x+3)(x−2)2(x−2)(x+2)​=−x+32(x+2)​
Try试一试
Simplify 10+3x−x2x2−25​ and state the NPVs.化简 10+3x−x2x2−25​，并写出不允许值。
Answer答案
−(x−5)(x+2)(x−5)(x+5)​=−x+2x+5​, x=5, −2−(x−5)(x+2)(x−5)(x+5)​=−x+2x+5​，x=5, −2

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简
  • x+3x+6​=36​ ✗ → nothing cancels across +.x+3x+6​=36​ ✗ → 加号连接的不能约。
  • Setting the numerator =0 for NPVs ✗ → only the denominator matters.令分子为 0 求不允许值 ✗ → 只看分母。
🎯
Write the NPVs on line 1, before simplifying — then you cannot lose them.第一行先写不允许值，再化简——就不会丢。

➗ Rational Expressions & Equations有理式与分式方程

Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除

Multiplying x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​ the long way gives a degree-3 mess. Factor first and almost everything cancels before you multiply.硬乘 x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​ 会得到一堆三次式。先分解，乘之前几乎全都约掉了。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除
  1. Multiply: factor everything, cancel any top with any bottom, then multiply what is left.乘法：全部分解，任一分子可与任一分母约分，再把剩下的相乘。
  2. Divide: multiply by the reciprocal of the SECOND fraction.除法：乘以第二个分式的倒数。
  3. Division NPVs: both denominators AND the numerator of the divisor.除法的不允许值：两个分母，再加上除式的分子。
BA​⋅DC​=BDAC​
BA​÷DC​=BA​⋅CD​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除

All the NPVs in a division除法里的全部不允许值

After flipping, the divisor numerator hides in the denominator and its restriction gets missed.翻转后除式的分子跑到分母里，它的限制最容易漏。

  1. x−3x+2​÷xx2−4​: denominators x=3, 0x−3x+2​÷xx2−4​：分母给出 x=3, 0
  2. Divisor numerator: x2−4=0 → x=±2除式分子：x2−4=0 → x=±2
  3. Flip & cancel: x−3x+2​⋅(x−2)(x+2)x​=(x−3)(x−2)x​翻转并约分：x−3x+2​⋅(x−2)(x+2)x​=(x−3)(x−2)x​
  4. NPVs: x=−2,0,2,3不允许值：x=−2,0,2,3
Try试一试
Simplify x+4x−1​÷x−1x2−9​ and state all NPVs.化简 x+4x−1​÷x−1x2−9​，并写出全部不允许值。
Answer答案
(x+4)(x−3)(x+3)(x−1)2​, x=−4, ±3, 1(x+4)(x−3)(x+3)(x−1)2​，x=−4, ±3, 1

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除
  • In ÷x+1x−5​, forgetting x=5 ✗ — it lands on the bottom after flipping.÷x+1x−5​ 漏写 x=5 ✗——翻转后它到了分母。
  • Cancelling across +: in xx+3​ nothing cancels.跨加号约分：xx+3​ 什么都不能约。
🎯
List the NPVs before you flip — three places, one line.翻转之前先列不允许值——三个来源，一行写完。

➗ Rational Expressions & Equations有理式与分式方程

Adding & subtracting有理式加减

21​+31​=65​ — you already know how. Adding x−23​−x+12​ is the exact same move: common denominator, then combine the tops.21​+31​=65​ 你早就会。x−23​−x+12​ 是一模一样的操作：通分，再合并分子。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Adding & subtracting有理式加减
  1. Factor every denominator; LCD = each different factor at its highest power.把每个分母分解；最简公分母＝每个不同因式取最高次幂。
  2. Rewrite over the LCD, then add or subtract the NUMERATORS only.化成同分母，只对分子加减。
  3. Subtracting: bracket the whole numerator, −(x−2)=−x+2; finish by factoring and cancelling.相减时整个分子加括号，−(x−2)=−x+2；最后分解分子看能否约分。
BA​±DC​=BDAD±BC​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Adding & subtracting有理式加减

Subtracting over a factored LCD在分解后的公分母上做减法

Three things go wrong at once: missing factors, the minus sign, and the final cancel.三件事同时容易出错：漏乘因式、减号分配、最后约分。

  1. x2−95​−x−32​: LCD (x−3)(x+3)x2−95​−x−32​：公分母 (x−3)(x+3)
  2. Top: 5−2(x+3) — bracket it分子：5−2(x+3)——加括号
  3. =5−2x−6=−2x−1 → (x−3)(x+3)−2x−1​, x=±3=5−2x−6=−2x−1 → (x−3)(x+3)−2x−1​，x=±3
Try试一试
Simplify x−4x​−x2−x−12x+24​.化简 x−4x​−x2−x−12x+24​。
Answer答案
(x−4)(x+3)x(x+3)−(x+24)​=(x−4)(x+3)(x+6)(x−4)​=x+3x+6​, x=4, −3(x−4)(x+3)x(x+3)−(x+24)​=(x−4)(x+3)(x+6)(x−4)​=x+3x+6​，x=4, −3

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Adding & subtracting有理式加减
  • x1​+y1​=x+y2​ ✗ → xyx+y​.x1​+y1​=x+y2​ ✗ → xyx+y​。
  • x−(x−2)=−2 ✗ → +2: the minus hits every term.x−(x−2)=−2 ✗ → +2：减号作用于每一项。
🎯
Opposite denominators (x−3 and 3−x): flip the sign of one fraction instead of multiplying them.分母互为相反数（x−3 与 3−x）：把其中一个分式变号即可，不用相乘。

➗ Rational Expressions & Equations有理式与分式方程

Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题

Two hoses together fill a hot tub in 4 hours, and the big one alone is 6 hours faster than the small one. How long does each take alone? Rates add as fractions — and one of the two answers you get is impossible.两根水管一起 4 小时灌满一个热水池，大水管单独灌比小水管快 6 小时。各自单独要多久？效率是分数相加——而你算出的两个答案里有一个不可能。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 45 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题
  1. NPVs first; then multiply EVERY term (whole numbers too) by the LCD.先写不允许值；再把每一项（包括整数项）都乘以公分母。
  2. An answer equal to an NPV is extraneous — reject it; all rejected → no solution.等于不允许值的解是增根，舍去；全部舍去 → 无解。
  3. Work: rates add, t1​1​+t2​1​=T1​. Travel: time =speeddistance​.工作问题：效率相加，t1​1​+t2​1​=T1​。行程问题：时间 =速度路程​。
t1​1​+t2​1​=T1​
t=vd​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题

Turning a work or travel story into an equation把工作／行程问题列成方程

The equation comes from rates or times, not from the hours given, so students add the wrong things.方程来自效率或时间的关系，而不是题目里的小时数本身，所以常加错东西。

  1. Pipe A: x h, B: x+5 h, together 6 h → rates x1​, x+51​, 61​A 管 x 小时，B 管 x+5 小时，合作 6 小时 → 效率 x1​, x+51​, 61​
  2. x1​+x+51​=61​
  3. ×6x(x+5): 6(x+5)+6x=x(x+5) → x2−7x−30=0两边乘 6x(x+5)：6(x+5)+6x=x(x+5) → x2−7x−30=0
  4. x=10 (reject −3): A 10 h, B 15 hx=10（舍去 −3）：A 用 10 小时，B 用 15 小时
Try试一试
A drone flies 12 km into a 4 km/h headwind and 12 km back with the wind, 1.6 h in all. Find its speed in still air.一架无人机逆风（风速 4 km/h）飞 12 km，再顺风飞回 12 km，共用 1.6 小时。求它在无风时的速度。
Answer答案
s−412​+s+412​=1.6 ⇒ s2−15s−16=0 ⇒ s=16 km/h (reject −1).s−412​+s+412​=1.6 ⇒ s2−15s−16=0 ⇒ s=16 km/h（舍去 −1）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题
  • 1+x2−412​: the 1 stays 1 ✗ → it becomes x2−4.1+x2−412​ 里的 1 不乘 ✗ → 它要变成 x2−4。
  • Together time =t1​+t2​ ✗ → add the RATES; together is faster than either alone.合作时间 =t1​+t2​ ✗ → 应该把效率相加；合作比任何一个人单干都快。
🎯
In word problems, make a small table (rate or speed, time) before writing the equation.应用题先列个小表（效率或速度、时间），再列方程。

quiz.q: A club rents a hall. Its average cost per member (in hundreds of dollars) is modelled by A(n)=n2−9n2+2n−15​, where n is the number of members. (a) Simplify A(n) and state all non-permissible values. (b) A treasurer enters n=3 into the simplified form and reports $133 per member. Explain why the original model gives no answer at n=3, so the report cannot be trusted. (c) Find A(5) both ways, and say what A(n) approaches when the club becomes very large.某俱乐部租一个场地，每位会员的平均费用（以百加元计）建模为 A(n)=n2−9n2+2n−15​，其中 n 是会员人数。(a) 化简 A(n) 并写出所有不允许值。(b) 财务把 n=3 代入化简式，报告每人 $133。解释为什么原模型在 n=3 时没有答案，所以这个报告不可信。(c) 用两种方式求 A(5)，并说明会员很多时 A(n) 趋近于什么。
quiz.a: (a) A(n)=n+3n+5​, n=±3; (b) the original has denominator 0 at n=3; (c) A(5)=45​ ($125), tending to 1 ($100).(a) A(n)=n+3n+5​，n=±3；(b) 原式在 n=3 时分母为 0；(c) A(5)=45​（$125），趋近于 1（$100）。
quiz.sol:
• (n−3)(n+3)(n+5)(n−3)​=n+3n+5​, with n=3 and n=−3 from the original denominator.(n−3)(n+3)(n+5)(n−3)​=n+3n+5​，原分母给出 n=3 和 n=−3。
  • At n=3 the original is 00​, undefined; the simplified form gives 68​=34​ (that is $133), but that value belongs to the simplified expression, not to the model. The model has a hole there.n=3 时原式是 00​，无意义；化简式给出 68​=34​（即 $133），但这个值属于化简式，不属于原模型。原模型在该点有一个「洞」。
  • A(5)=25−925+10−15​=1620​=45​ from the original, and 810​=45​ from the simplified form: $125 per member.A(5) 用原式：25−925+10−15​=1620​=45​；用化简式：810​=45​。结果相同，每人 $125。
  • As n grows, n+32​→0, so A(n)→1, about $100 per member.n 越大，n+32​→0，所以 A(n)→1，约每人 $100。
quiz.goal: Simplify a cost model, keep its restrictions, and interpret a hole and long-run behaviour in context.化简费用模型，保留限制条件，并在情境中解释「洞」与长期趋势。
quiz.idea: Simplifying does not remove a restriction; the original expression defines the model.化简不会消除限制条件；原式才定义了这个模型。

quiz.q: State all NPVs of x−5x​÷x−1x+2​, then simplify.写出 x−5x​÷x−1x+2​ 的全部不允许值，再化简。
quiz.a: (x−5)(x+2)x(x−1)​, x=5,1,−2(x−5)(x+2)x(x−1)​，x=5,1,−2
quiz.sol:
• Bottoms: x=5, x=1. Divisor top: x=−2.分母：x=5，x=1。除式分子：x=−2。
  • x−5x​⋅x+2x−1​=(x−5)(x+2)x(x−1)​.x−5x​⋅x+2x−1​=(x−5)(x+2)x(x−1)​。
quiz.goal: State all NPVs before simplifying a division of two rational expressions.在化简有理式除法之前先写出全部不允许值。
quiz.idea: Four conditions: both denominators and the divisor numerator.共四个条件：两个分母，加上除式的分子。

quiz.q: A rectangle has area x+1x2−9​ and length x2−1x+3​. Find an expression for its width.一个长方形面积为 x+1x2−9​，长为 x2−1x+3​。求宽的表达式。
quiz.a: (x−3)(x−1)
quiz.sol:
• x+1(x−3)(x+3)​⋅x+3(x−1)(x+1)​=(x−3)(x−1).x+1(x−3)(x+3)​⋅x+3(x−1)(x+1)​=(x−3)(x−1)。
  • In context the sides must be positive, so x>3.在实际问题中边长必须为正，所以 x>3。
quiz.goal: Find an unknown side of a rectangle by dividing rational expressions.用有理式除法求长方形的未知边。
quiz.idea: Width = area ÷ length.宽 = 面积 ÷ 长。

quiz.q: A ferry route is modelled with a design parameter x>4. The crossing distance is D=xx2−16​ km and the ferry speed is v=x2x2−x−12​ km/min. (a) Write the crossing time t=D÷v as one simplified expression and list every non-permissible value. (b) Explain why only x>4 makes sense for the story. (c) For x=8, find D, v and t, and convert v to km/h.一条渡轮航线用设计参数 x>4 建模。航程为 D=xx2−16​ km，渡轮速度为 v=x2x2−x−12​ km/min。(a) 把航行时间 t=D÷v 写成一个最简式，并列出所有不允许值。(b) 说明为什么只有 x>4 才符合情境。(c) 当 x=8 时求 D、v、t，并把 v 换算成 km/h。
quiz.a: (a) t=x+3x(x+4)​ min, x=0,4,−3; (b) x−4>0 makes both D and v positive; (c) D=6 km, v=1611​ km/min =41.25 km/h, t=1196​≈8.7 min.(a) t=x+3x(x+4)​ 分钟，x=0,4,−3；(b) x−4>0 才使 D 和 v 同为正；(c) D=6 km，v=1611​ km/min =41.25 km/h，t=1196​≈8.7 分钟。
quiz.sol:
• t=x(x−4)(x+4)​⋅(x−4)(x+3)x2​=x+3x(x+4)​.t=x(x−4)(x+4)​⋅(x−4)(x+3)x2​=x+3x(x+4)​。
  • NPVs: x=0 (from D and v), x=4 and x=−3 (zeros of the divisor numerator x2−x−12).不允许值：x=0（来自 D 和 v 的分母），x=4 和 x=−3（除式分子 x2−x−12 的零点）。
  • Distance and speed are positive only if x−4>0 (the other factors x+4, x+3, x are then positive), so x>4.距离和速度为正，必须 x−4>0（此时其余因式 x+4、x+3、x 都为正），所以 x>4。
  • x=8: D=848​=6 km; v=6464−8−12​=6444​=1611​ km/min =1611​⋅60=41.25 km/h; t=11/166​=1196​≈8.7 min, matching 118⋅12​=1196​.x=8：D=848​=6 km；v=6464−8−12​=6444​=1611​ km/min =1611​⋅60=41.25 km/h；t=11/166​=1196​≈8.7 分钟，与 118⋅12​=1196​ 一致。
quiz.goal: Divide two rational models, collect every restriction, and match them to the sensible domain in context.对两个有理式模型做除法，收集全部限制，并与情境下合理的范围对应。
quiz.idea: Time is distance divided by speed; the divisor numerator becomes a denominator, adding NPVs.时间 = 距离 ÷ 速度；除式的分子翻转后成了分母，会增加不允许值。

quiz.goal: Add rational expressions whose denominators are trinomials sharing one factor.加分母为三项式且含一个公因式的有理式。

quiz.goal: Simplify a complex fraction by combining the numerator first.先合并分子，化简繁分式。
quiz.idea: Combine x1​−21​=2x2−x​, then divide by x−2 and use the opposite-factor rule.先合并 x1​−21​=2x2−x​，再除以 x−2，用相反因式规则。

quiz.q: A cyclist rides 60 km uphill to a lookout at x km/h and returns the same 60 km downhill at (x+10) km/h. (a) Write the total time as one fraction, simplified, and state the restrictions in context. (b) Write the average speed for the whole trip, total time120​, as a single simplified expression. (c) For x=20 find the average speed and explain why it is not the mean of 20 and 30.一名骑行者以 x km/h 的速度上坡骑 60 km 到观景台，再以 (x+10) km/h 的速度下坡骑回同样的 60 km。(a) 把总时间写成一个化简后的分式，并说明情境下的限制。(b) 把全程平均速度 总时间120​ 写成一个化简的式子。(c) 当 x=20 时求平均速度，并解释为什么它不是 20 与 30 的平均数。
quiz.a: (a) T=x(x+10)60(2x+10)​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​ h, x>0; (b) vˉ=x+5x(x+10)​; (c) 24 km/h.(a) T=x(x+10)60(2x+10)​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​ 小时，x>0；(b) vˉ=x+5x(x+10)​；(c) 24 km/h。
quiz.sol:
• T=x60​+x+1060​=x(x+10)60(x+10)+60x​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​. Speeds are positive, so x>0 (and x=0,−10 is automatic).T=x60​+x+1060​=x(x+10)60(x+10)+60x​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​。速度为正，所以 x>0（x=0,−10 自然满足）。
  • vˉ=120÷T=120(x+5)120x(x+10)​=x+5x(x+10)​.vˉ=120÷T=120(x+5)120x(x+10)​=x+5x(x+10)​。
  • x=20: vˉ=2520⋅30​=24 km/h. Time uphill is 3 h and downhill 2 h, so 120 km in 5 h. More time is spent at the slower speed, so the average is pulled below 25.x=20：vˉ=2520⋅30​=24 km/h。上坡 3 小时、下坡 2 小时，共 120 km 用 5 小时。在较慢的速度上花的时间更多，平均速度被拉到 25 以下。
quiz.goal: Add rational expressions from a rate context, simplify an average speed, and explain why it is not the simple mean.在速度情境中做有理式加法，化简平均速度，并解释它为何不是简单平均。
quiz.idea: Add times, not speeds; average speed is total distance over total time.要加的是时间，不是速度；平均速度 = 总路程 ÷ 总时间。

quiz.q: A cyclist rides 30 km. If she rode 5 km/h faster, the trip would take 1 h less. Find her actual speed.一名骑车人骑行 30 km。如果她每小时快 5 km，就能少用 1 小时。求她实际的速度。
quiz.a: 10 km/h
quiz.sol:
• Multiply by v(v+5): 30(v+5)−30v=v(v+5) → v2+5v−150=0 → (v+15)(v−10)=0.乘以 v(v+5)：30(v+5)−30v=v(v+5) → v2+5v−150=0 → (v+15)(v−10)=0。
  • Speed cannot be negative, so v=10 km/h. Check: 3 h vs 2 h ✓.速度不能为负，所以 v=10 km/h。检验：3 小时与 2 小时 ✓。
quiz.goal: Solve a speed problem where the time difference is given.解已知时间差的速度应用题。
quiz.idea: Time =x30​ versus x+530​, and the difference is 1 h.时间是 x30​ 与 x+530​，相差 1 小时。

quiz.q: A boat goes 24 km upstream and 24 km back in 5 h. The current is 2 km/h. Find the boat’s speed in still water.一艘船逆流行 24 km 再顺流返回 24 km，共用 5 小时。水流速度 2 km/h，求船在静水中的速度。
quiz.a: 10 km/h
quiz.sol:
• 24(v+2)+24(v−2)=5(v2−4) → 5v2−48v−20=0 → (5v+2)(v−10)=0.24(v+2)+24(v−2)=5(v2−4) → 5v2−48v−20=0 → (5v+2)(v−10)=0。
  • Reject v=−52​. v=10 km/h. Check: 824​+1224​=3+2=5 ✓.舍去 v=−52​，v=10 km/h。检验：824​+1224​=3+2=5 ✓。
quiz.goal: Model an upstream/downstream trip with current and solve.为含水流的顺逆水行程建模并求解。
quiz.idea: Speeds are x−2 and x+2; add the two times and set equal to 5.速度分别是 x−2 与 x+2；两段时间相加等于 5。

quiz.q: A junior hockey team rents ice for $378 and splits the cost equally among its players. When 3 more players join, each player pays $3 less. (a) Write an equation for the original number of players x and solve it. (b) Explain which solutions are rejected and why. (c) Verify with the actual share per player before and after.一支青少年冰球队租冰场花 $378，由队员平均分摊。又有 3 名队员加入后，每人少付 $3。(a) 为原来的队员人数 x 列方程并求解。(b) 说明哪个解要舍去，为什么。(c) 用加入前后每人实际分摊的钱验证。
quiz.a: (a) x378​−x+3378​=3 gives x=18; (b) x=−21 is rejected (people cannot be negative); (c) $21 before, $18 after.(a) x378​−x+3378​=3 得 x=18；(b) x=−21 舍去（人数不能为负）；(c) 加入前每人 $21，加入后 $18。
quiz.sol:
• Original share x378​, new share x+3378​, so x378​−x+3378​=3 with x=0,−3.原来每人 x378​，现在每人 x+3378​，所以 x378​−x+3378​=3，x=0,−3。
  • Multiply by x(x+3): 378(x+3)−378x=3x(x+3), so 1134=3x2+9x and x2+3x−378=0.乘 x(x+3)：378(x+3)−378x=3x(x+3)，即 1134=3x2+9x，得 x2+3x−378=0。
  • Factor: (x−18)(x+21)=0. A number of players must be positive, so x=18; x=−21 is rejected.分解：(x−18)(x+21)=0。人数必须为正，所以 x=18；x=−21 舍去。
  • Check: 18378​=21 and 21378​=18, a drop of $3. ✓验证：18378​=21，21378​=18，少了 $3。✓
quiz.goal: Model a cost-sharing situation with a rational equation, solve it, and justify rejecting a negative root.用分式方程为分摊费用的情境建模、求解，并说明为何舍去负根。
quiz.idea: Share = total ÷ people; compare two shares, then clear fractions with the LCD.每人分摊 = 总额 ÷ 人数；比较两个分摊额，再用最小公分母去分母。

diag.q: State the non-permissible values of x2+3x−10x2−4​.写出 x2+3x−10x2−4​ 的不允许值。
c: x=±2
x=−5
x=5, −2
x=−5, 2
why: Used the numerator; NPVs come from the denominator only.用了分子；不允许值只看分母。
Cancelled (x−2) first and lost its restriction; take NPVs from the original.先约掉 (x−2)，把它的限制丢了；要从原式写。
Sign slip: (x+5)(x−2)=0 gives x=−5 and x=2.符号错：(x+5)(x−2)=0 得 x=−5 和 x=2。
Correct: x2+3x−10=(x+5)(x−2).正确：x2+3x−10=(x+5)(x−2)。

diag.idea: Factor the bottom; each factor =0.分解分母，每个因式 =0。

−x+23​, x=−2
−x+23​, x=±2
4−x23x−6​, x=±2
why: Missed the opposite factor: 4−x2=(2−x)(2+x), and 2−xx−2​=−1.没注意相反因式：4−x2=(2−x)(2+x)，2−xx−2​=−1。
Lost the NPV x=2 by stating restrictions after cancelling.约分后才写限制，丢了 x=2。
Correct: −(x−2)(x+2)3(x−2)​=−x+23​, x=±2.正确：−(x−2)(x+2)3(x−2)​=−x+23​，x=±2。
Thought nothing cancels because x−2 and 2−x look different; they are opposites.以为 x−2 和 2−x 不一样所以不能约；它们互为相反数。
diag.goal: Simplify using an opposite factor and keep all NPVs.利用相反因式化简，并保留全部不允许值。
diag.idea: Factor both: 3(x−2) over −(x−2)(x+2).上下都分解：3(x−2) 比 −(x−2)(x+2)。

diag.q: Simplify 3xx2−25​⋅x+56x2​.化简 3xx2−25​⋅x+56x2​。
c: 2(x−5)
2x(x+5)
2x(x−5)
2xx−5​
why: Cancelled x2 with x completely; xx2​=x leaves one x.把 x2 和 x 全约掉了；xx2​=x 还剩一个 x。
Factored x2−25 wrong or cancelled the wrong bracket; (x+5) cancels, (x−5) stays.x2−25 分解错或约错了括号；约掉的是 (x+5)，留下 (x−5)。
